LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 WORD CLASSES: SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple Prepositions, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we show the relationship between words? 2. Why should you ensure all your sentences are correctly written?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: A learner manipulates digital devices and use them to create word puzzles and share them with others

● Communication and collaboration: A learner speaks clearly and effectively during dramatisation of narratives and

discussion of moral lessons.

Values:
Unity: A learner works together to construct sentences using prepositions.

Link to other subjects:

Languages like French, German, Arabic, and Kiswahili have prepositions as an area of study
